title: Craft hovering in S4 hangars

tellings.quote: So they actually went all the way to S4 uh and went down in the big elevators and went in and he said he saw like three or four.

plain: Three or four craft were seen hovering inside the hangars of S4, a secret site near Area 51 in Nevada, according to an account relayed by the lawyer Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells Michels that "they actually went all the way to S4," rode down "the big elevators," and that "he said he saw like three or four," in an account that also names Oscar Wolf, Bob Lazar and Dan Burisch, men he links to the site, without making clear which of them was the one who saw it. If true, it would mean the site held several working craft at once.
